FACT_ID: sec11-R01 | anchor: A01
Top causes run speeding, bad yielding, and drink, while exchanges run names through insurance with verbatim policy copies [A01].
Why it matters: group crash-basics; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec11-F01 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec11-R02 | anchor: A01
Four triggers summon police at once, while minor uninvestigated crashes file written reports within ten days under one thousand dollars [A01].
Why it matters: group crash-reporting; difficulty medium; prereq sec11-F01; confusables sec11-F02, sec11-F03 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec11-R03 | anchor: A01
Injury crashes stop, identify, and aid, while vehicle-only crashes stop, move drivable cars clear, and identify [A01].
Why it matters: group stop-duties; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec11-F04, sec11-F06 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec11-R04 | anchor: A01
Fleeing death draws second-degree felony years, serious injury draws third-degree felony years, and plain injury draws prison or jail plus fines [A01].
Why it matters: group fleeing-penalties; difficulty high; prereq sec11-F04; confusables sec11-F05 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec11-R05 | anchor: A02
Property-only fleeing splits at two hundred dollars, Class C below and Class B with jail above [A02].
Why it matters: group fleeing-penalties; difficulty low; prereq sec11-F05; confusables sec11-F07 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0066]

FACT_ID: sec11-R06 | anchor: A02
Unattended cars get found owners or visible notes, while fixtures get found owners, notice, and possible ten-day reports [A02].
Why it matters: group property-crashes; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec11-F08, sec11-F09 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0066]

FACT_ID: sec11-R07 | anchor: A02
Hit-and-runs need police reports for coverage, and injured victims need clear locations, skilled help, stillness, pressure pads, and shelter [A02].
Why it matters: group aftermath; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec11-F10 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0066]
